versions.subject: refactor and new: lsass process dumping rules
refactor: extended rules and made them more exact
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetImage|endswith: '\lsass.exe'
    SourceImage|contains: 'dump'
    GrantedAccess|endswith:
        - '10'
        - '30'
        - '50'
        - '70'
        - '90'
        - 'B0'
        - 'D0'
        - 'F0'
        - '18'
        - '38'
        - '58'
        - '78'
        - '98'
        - 'B8'
        - 'D8'
        - 'F8'
        - '1A'
        - '3A'
        - '5A'
        - '7A'
        - '9A'
        - 'BA'
        - 'DA'
        - 'FA'
        - '0x14C2'  # https://github.com/b4rtik/ATPMiniDump/blob/master/ATPMiniDump/ATPMiniDump.c
        - 'FF'
condition: selection
